sourceCoordinateRules.text: Apply node.matrix then text.glyphTextMatrix once for glyphs. Source declared bounds use node.matrix only. Run cursor resets only when changed.xOffset is true.
sourceCoordinateRules.color: Apply combined colorTransform per shape paint/native run. Do not also apply alpha to a parent group.
sourceCoordinateRules.paintOrder: Array order is source display-list paint order; white shapes remain paint, no synthesized clipping.
sourceCoordinateRules.masks: No active clipDepth in the selected root+intro+idle-button scene. clipRefs empty by checked source evidence.
sourceCoordinateRules.buttonState: Flat frames use source idle/up state, and preserve authored pressed/hover demonstrations already placed directly on main. All real button state definitions and local alternatives retained separately.
sourceCoordinateRules.glossary: Keyboard activation needs visible source-word ink with no conservative intersection against later visible shape fills. Native font/browser visibility still requires actual review.
